title: Kingdom Laws For The Home

obedience when we show approval to our children when we praise them in the little things they always want to keep doing it so good so that we can praise them more mothers our job as parents is not done or is not completed until the child has obeyed we must see that obedience is carried out let me give you three reasons why some of us fail in administering the law of obedience we give our children too many orders and we must not give our children an order unless it matters enough to us that we will follow through on that order to assure the child's obedience in other words whatever you ask them to do make sure they obey you and do it secondly never leave a disciplinary job undone don't tell them you will deal with them later do it now because one time later is too late some mothers 3 some mothers might not want to discipline a child because of disobedience because they are afraid the child might not like them if they demand obedience of the child parents children do not grow to love those who are afraid to confront them they come to despise them remember it is far easier in the long run to deal with a tantrum throwing six-year-old don't to deal with a stubborn 16 year old
